sourceFile: 05. BRS-161016 Report check VP+CD waiting long time to Led UV afer bonding_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable evidence but misidentifies the primary factor and includes several misparsed outcomes.
issues: Primary factor should be waiting time to LED UV after bonding, not vague Normal vs test.
Baseline/test conditions are ambiguous; Normal may be a reference row, not the changed factor.
Several measurement outcomes are parsing artifacts from mixed rows or pictures.
Bonding amount appears to be setup/control data, not a comparison outcome.
VP deformation status section is not properly captured as an outcome.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to VP+CD waiting time before LED UV with each wait time as condition.
Use Normal only as baseline/reference if supported by table headers and rows.
Keep valid outcomes for vision status, tension test, and VP deformation under the same factor.
Remove or recalculate misparsed picture and bonding-amount measurement outcomes.
Cite header rows plus all relevant data rows for each outcome table.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but current citations are insufficient because grouping and parsed metrics are unreliable.
